headline: A 2014 law renames a Vallejo, California Postal Service building after Philmore Graham.
what_it_does: This law gives the United States Postal Service building at 100 Admiral Callaghan Lane in Vallejo, California, the official name "Philmore Graham Post Office Building." It is an honorary naming measure. It does not change how the post office operates, what services it offers, or any rules for people who use it.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 16, 2014.
